newsitem.title: USA: Hills Stores August same-store sales eased.
newsitem.headline: Hills Stores August same-store sales eased.

text.p: Hills Stores Co Thursday reported sales for the four weeks and year-to-date periods ended August 31.
Sales in millions of dollars Percent change
Chief executive Gregory K. Raven estimated August sales may have been negatively impacted by 1 to 2 percent due to the way the fiscal calendar fell.

"Our August fiscal month, which began on August 4th and concluded on August 31st, had no 'first of the month' selling days. The 'first of the month' is an important shopping period, since many of our customers receive monthly checks during the first few days of the month," he explained.

"Our sales momentum in the past two months has improved as we were able to reverse the erosion of customer foot traffic which had occurred earlier in the year. This includes an improving trend in apparel sales," Raven said.
